symbols.note: copied by hand from gatekit symbols system --dll dx11 (addresses are bg3_dx11.exe). Methods with null address were listed by the Toolkit but the tool printed no game address for them. System index variable bg3_dx11.exe+0x60D9798; the game functions using the index are in the Toolkit line of the tool output. The does layer cites EoCServer.dll (Toolkit pseudo-code with real names) wherever bg3_dx11.exe functions were not individually mapped.
symbols.limits: reads/writes: the component views in the parameters of the system's exported methods. uses: the component operations (add, remove, get, has) its per-frame update performs through the engine's out-of-line helpers, itself or in a function it calls (depth 2), with the call site; kind index: a matched method reads the type's index and the operation is not known. Not listed: operations the compiler inlined, those deeper than depth 2, and what a method that is not the update does (e.g. a SystemLoad) - read its pseudo-code; an empty writes list is not "writes nothing".

does.text: Runs two steps each frame in a fixed order: first CreateMagicPocketsMovementRequests, then ProcessInventoryChanges.
does.evidence: Update body read, EoCServer.dll+0xF6EEF0; bg3_dx11.exe registration function bg3_dx11.exe+0x2379620 (540 b) names the four component types the system queries (MagicPocketsTrackRequests and EntityMovedMagicPockets written, EntityMergeEvent and MemberAddedEvent read)

does.text: If the request list at this+0x10 is non-empty, it creates one new entity through the deferred command buffer, adds one component to it, and puts every still-alive entity of the list into a set held by that component; then it empties the list. The component's type is not named at the add; MagicPocketsTrackRequestsOneFrameComponent, from the WorldView's write list, is the likely one.
does.evidence: EoCServer.dll+0xF6DE70 read: CreateEntity on the deferred buffer, one AddComponent through helper EoCServer.dll+0xF6D100, set insert per alive entity, list cleared

does.text: Looks at entities added this frame (an added-tag query), copies request data into a scratch list of StackMergedEntityData, and destroys one entity through the command buffer, probably the consumed request entity. No AddComponent was seen in the body itself; that it writes EntityMovedMagicPocketsEventOneFrameComponent rests on the write list only. MemberAddedEvent and EntityMergeEvent are read-only inputs.
does.evidence: EoCServer.dll+0xF6E170 searched for add, remove and destroy calls: added-tag queries and one DestroyEntity; no AddComponent in the body
